quest.title: To Guiztli Ridge!
quest.description: Chasca told you about some head-to-head challenges at Guiztli Ridge...
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x350, Primogem x40, Mora x30000, Hero's Wit x4, Mystic Enhancement Ore x4, Easybreeze Badge x1

dialogues.text: Brave adventurers, welcome to Villa Guiztli! You're just in time to witness our annual Pome Night celebration!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oooh, Paimon likes the sound of that! This place has a great vibe already!

dialogues.speaker: Bennett
dialogues.text: Hello there, Mr...?

dialogues.speaker: "Willapi"
dialogues.text: Nanasian.

dialogues.speaker: Bennett
dialogues.text: Excuse me, Mr. Nanasian, could you point us in the direction of the town? Is there anything we should bring?

dialogues.speaker: "Willapi"
dialogues.text: Haha. Just from hearing your question, I can tell I'm speaking to an experienced adventurer.

dialogues.speaker: "Willapi"
dialogues.text: Just head downhill from here, and you'll soon arrive at the charming town of Villa Guiztli.

dialogues.speaker: "Willapi"
dialogues.text: As for things to take... You'll need a bold spirit, a heart eager to help others, and a dash of courage to face any challenges that may lie ahead.

dialogues.speaker: "Willapi"
dialogues.text: Ah, I see you've brought a little companion along with you. Would you mind keeping him in your bag for now, just in case something... unexpected happens?

dialogues.speaker: "Willapi"
dialogues.text: Okay, all set! Brave challengers, your adventure is about to begin. I wish you all an exciting and unforgettable night ahead!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Whoa, this cave's way bigger than Paimon expected. Looks like a lot of work was put into this town.

dialogues.speaker: Bennett
dialogues.text: Hey, is that... a bounty board?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Let Paimon see... One zero, two zeros, three zeros, four...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Five zeros, six zeros... and there's even a five in front! ... That's five million Mora! Holy— Eek, something's coming!

dialogues.speaker: Alpaca Sheriff
dialogues.text: Esteemed guests, welcome to the beautiful town of Villa Guiztli.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: ...Geez, you almost gave Paimon a heart attack!

dialogues.speaker: Alpaca Sheriff
dialogues.text: You must be here for Pome Night. *sigh* I'm sorry to report we won't be celebrating the festival this year.

dialogues.speaker: Mualani
dialogues.text: Oh, did something happen?

dialogues.speaker: Alpaca Sheriff
dialogues.text: Not long ago, those Nochtli ruffians ransacked our beautiful town and seized all our gold and treasure.

dialogues.speaker: Alpaca Sheriff
dialogues.text: Even now, their ringleader's still holed up in the town. And worse — not only is he refusing to leave, he expects us to do his bidding.

dialogues.speaker: Bennett
dialogues.text: That's awful! Can't you do something about it?

dialogues.speaker: Alpaca Sheriff
dialogues.text: Well, it's a long story. Anyway, you all made quite the journey to get here. Why don't we head over to the bar for a quick drink?

talks.objective: Follow the sheriff to the bar

dialogues.speaker: Bennett
dialogues.text: What happened next, Sheriff?

dialogues.speaker: Alpaca Sheriff
dialogues.text: He disappeared... and no one knows what happened after that.

dialogues.speaker: Alpaca Sheriff
dialogues.text: Some say he took a new name. Others claim he and his companions embarked on a one-way journey to a land as hot as the blazing sun...

dialogues.speaker: Alpaca Sheriff
dialogues.text: If you ever happen to run into him, please let him know how grateful we are for everything he did for us — and also, that we miss him very much.

dialogues.speaker: Chasca
dialogues.text: If we see him, we'll make sure to pass the message along.

dialogues.speaker: Alpaca Sheriff
dialogues.text: Alright, this is the Nochtli gang's hideout. I tailed one of their henchmen once, so I know how to activate the door mechanism, and I can get it open for you.

dialogues.speaker: Alpaca Sheriff
dialogues.text: But this place is under heavy watch. I'll be a sitting duck if I go alone. So, I need some backup.

dialogues.speaker: Chasca
dialogues.text: What do you need us to do?

dialogues.speaker: Alpaca Sheriff
dialogues.text: Knock out anyone who tries to get in my way.

dialogues.speaker: Bennett
dialogues.text: Hehe, now that's a gutsy request.

dialogues.speaker: Chasca
dialogues.text: Leave it to me.

dialogues.speaker: Mualani
dialogues.text: Heh, I knew Chasca wouldn't need a lot of convincing on that one...

dialogues.speaker: Chasca
dialogues.text: #{NICKNAME}, cover that gun for me, will you?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Copy that.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Man, wish we had backup like this all those times we had to go sneaking around...

talks.objective: Help the sheriff activate the mechanism

dialogues.speaker: Chasca
dialogues.text: #Hmph, wow, you won, {NICKNAME}. You're a pretty good shot. Almost seems like you've done this before.

dialogues.speaker: Chasca
dialogues.text: Here, let me teach you how to fire off rapid bursts of bullets. It might come in handy someday.

dialogues.speaker: Bennett
dialogues.text: Oh, shoot!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Wh—What happened?

dialogues.speaker: Bennett
dialogues.text: I got distracted for a split second, and now the Sheriff's been caught...

dialogues.speaker: Chasca
dialogues.text: Let's go after him!

dialogues.speaker: Chasca
dialogues.text: Too bad, you handled that gun pretty well. Guess you just haven't had enough chances to practice.

dialogues.speaker: Chasca
dialogues.text: Here, let me teach you how to fire off rapid bursts of bullets. It might come in handy someday.

dialogues.speaker: Bennett
dialogues.text: Oh, shoot!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Wh—What happened?

dialogues.speaker: Bennett
dialogues.text: I got distracted for a split second, and now the Sheriff's been caught...

dialogues.speaker: Chasca
dialogues.text: Let's go after him!

talks.objective: Ride the cruise ship and continue your pursuit

dialogues.speaker: Nochtli Ruffian
dialogues.text: Aha, the meddling outsiders have arrived, I see.

dialogues.speaker: Nochtli Lackey
dialogues.text: Ah! Careful, boss, they got a gun!

dialogues.speaker: Nochtli Ruffian
dialogues.text: A little firepower's got you spooked? Hah, disappointing.

dialogues.speaker: Nochtli Ruffian
dialogues.text: Alright then, show-offs, let's see who's the quicker shot.

dialogues.speaker: Bennett
dialogues.text: There's a ton of smoke over there. What happened?

dialogues.speaker: Chasca
dialogues.text: He got away.

dialogues.speaker: Mualani
dialogues.text: Whoa, no one outruns Chasca's gun...

dialogues.speaker: Chasca
dialogues.text: Truth is, the leader never planned to fight us. All that talk was just a distraction — a way to create an opening. He was planning to make a run for it all along.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hmph, acting all tough and then running away like that... What a joke.

dialogues.speaker: Mualani
dialogues.text: Uh-oh... The exit's blocked. Looks like another trap.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: What should we do? Is there some kind of mechanism we can use?

dialogues.speaker: Bennett
dialogues.text: Look, there's a bunch of cages down in the canyon. Let's go save those captives first.

talks.objective: Find a way to lift the barrier
Investigate the inside of the cavern

dialogues.speaker: Chasca
dialogues.text: Alright, we've dealt with those monsters, and the Abyssal energy seems to be gone too.

dialogues.speaker: Chasca
dialogues.text: Is everyone okay?

dialogues.speaker: Bennett
dialogues.text: I got a scrape on my arm, but it's nothing. Doesn't even hurt.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Let me take a look.

dialogues.speaker: Bennett
dialogues.text: Oh, sure... Sorry for making you worry...

response.speaker: Chasca
response.text: Glad to hear it.

response.speaker: Mualani
response.text: Don't you think something weird's going on?

response.speaker: Mualani
response.text: I mean... those Hilichurl Rogues could be actors in costume. But, there shouldn't be any actual Abyssal monsters here, right?

response.speaker: Chasca
response.text: Yeah, there's no way that's meant to be part of the experience.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Plus, the way we came in is blocked now. Everything was fine until the monsters showed up...

response.speaker: Bennett
response.text: Oh no... My bad luck must be back... and I'm dragging everyone down with me...

response.speaker: Chasca
response.text: Hey, don't think like that.

response.speaker: Chasca
response.text: Abyssal monsters can appear for many reasons. Being attracted by someone or... something is certainly one possibility.

response.speaker: Chasca
response.text: Now isn't the time to blame ourselves. We should focus on identifying any hidden dangers instead.

response.speaker: Chasca
response.text: We still don't know what might have happened outside the cave.

response.speaker: Bennett
response.text: You're right. Okay, I'll take the lead and scout ahead!

response.speaker: Chasca
response.text: Hah, sorry. I'm gonna have to call dibs on that one.

response.speaker: Chasca
response.text: We should do this the Natlan way. As the most mobile member of the team, leave the scouting to me. It happens to be a Flower-Feather Clan specialty.

response.speaker: Chasca
response.text: Alright, I'll go check on the situation outside. See you soon.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Wait but, the cave's still...

response.speaker: Chasca
response.text: Get back.

response.speaker: Mualani
response.text: Wait a sec, we're not ready y—

response.speaker: Black Screen
response.text: BOOM!

response.speaker: Bennett
response.text: Heh, she sure is a fast flyer. I can't even see her anymore...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Well at least there's a way out now... Wait, what are you looking at?

response.speaker: Black Screen
response.text: (Readable pops up)

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: The Tecpatl's Flintblades Adventure Team, Anja, Macani... Huh, Paimon doesn't recognize any of those names.

response.speaker: Mualani
response.text: Hmm... Neither do I.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Well, guess we're still pretty much in the dark, then. We should just make a note of it and move on for now.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Everything okay, Bennett?

response.speaker: Bennett
response.text: Oh... Yeah, I'm fine. You guys think it's probably better not to move anything around in the amusement area, right?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Yeah, better not.

response.speaker: Bennett
response.text: Alright then, let's go.

choices.text: But it didn't say if anything else happened afterwards...

talks.objective: Leave the cavern and ride the cruise ship again
Bring down "El Capoctus Joquiratto"'s hot air balloon
Go to where the hot air balloon crashed on top of the mountain

dialogues.speaker: Chasca
dialogues.text: Let him go.

dialogues.speaker: "El Capoctus Joquiratto"
dialogues.text: Surrender now, and maybe, just maybe, I'll let him live.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Whew, that was one big hill... Paimon's hair is dry already. Wait, that's... Chasca!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: And El Capoctus Joquiratto!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: And Nana... Uh, Paimon forgot the rest...

dialogues.speaker: "Willapi"
dialogues.text: Shush...

dialogues.speaker: "El Capoctus Joquiratto"
dialogues.text: I'll say it one last time — if you want him to live, drop your weapons and surrender!

dialogues.speaker: "El Capoctus Joquiratto"
dialogues.text: You shoot or try any other funny business, and I'll throw him right off this cliff.

dialogues.speaker: "Willapi"
dialogues.text: Please... I'm begging you, don't do this...

dialogues.speaker: Mualani
dialogues.text: That's weird... What's Chasca waiting for?

choices.text: Maybe there really is a bad guy...

response.speaker: Bennett
response.text: Huh? You mean like... someone replaced the actor?

response.speaker: Mualani
response.text: If we factor in those Abyssal monsters that came out of nowhere, does that mean this is...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: ...Actually real!?

response.speaker: "El Capoctus Joquiratto"
response.text: Enough! Even my patience has its limits.

response.speaker: "El Capoctus Joquiratto"
response.text: Back off now, all of you! Get away from the cliff!

response.speaker: "Willapi"
response.text: Run, adventurers, run! Leave the town, leave me to my fate!

response.speaker: Player
response.text: (Hey, that's...!)

response.speaker: Black Screen
response.text: (Insert Chasca's QTE showdown)

response.speaker: Gunshot
response.text: Boom!

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Well that's that.

response.speaker: "Willapi"
response.text: Thank you, brave adventurers! You saved Villa Guiztli, and you saved me too!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hey, look over there!

response.speaker: Bennett
response.text: Asha...?

response.speaker: Mualani
response.text: El Capoctus Joquiratto... was played by a bunch of Asha!?

response.speaker: "Willapi"
response.text: Congratulations, everyone! You bravely chose the path of justice and vanquished the wicked El Capoctus Joquiratto!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Okay, okay, hold on... So, it wasn't real? We all freaked out for nothing?

response.speaker: Chasca
response.text: I mean, there was cause for concern — I was worried, too.

response.speaker: Chasca
response.text: Even though I didn't see any other Abyssal monsters on the way here, I didn't let my guard down.

response.speaker: Chasca
response.text: Under normal circumstances, I would've taken the shot without hesitation. With Soulsniper on my side, I'm confident I could get to the hostage no problem, even if the hostile tried to harm them.

response.speaker: Chasca
response.text: But this time, it seemed like our enemy was tainted by the Abyss, so we couldn't afford to take any chances. We had to factor in the worst-case scenario.

response.speaker: Chasca
response.text: #So, the only option was for {NICKNAME} and I to strike at the same time, ensuring we took down the villain and rescued the hostage in one fell swoop.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Wow, good thing you two got a chance to work on your teamwork against those lackeys earlier...

response.speaker: Chasca
response.text: In hindsight, it's clear the only place where things went wrong was that cave.

response.speaker: Mualani
response.text: So, since we cleared out those monsters already, we're in the clear?

response.speaker: Chasca
response.text: We should be.

response.speaker: "Willapi"
response.text: Sorry, I don't follow. By "cave," you're not referring to somewhere inside one of our amusement facilities, are you...?

response.speaker: Mualani
response.text: Yeah, we came across an adventurer camp inside the cave. Y'know, near the spot where the Sheriff snuffs it... Oh, um, sorry. That came out a little harsh...

response.speaker: "Willapi"
response.text: But... There's no cave or camp anywhere near there...

response.speaker: "Willapi"
response.text: You sure it wasn't your eyes playing tricks on you?

response.speaker: Bennett
response.text: No, definitely not. First, we were ambushed by monsters, then we even read through the adventurer's notes. There's no way it was just an illusion.

response.speaker: Bennett
response.text: Oh, we even have evidence! The scratch on my arm is still there! Haha, guess there was a silver lining to getting hurt, after all.

response.speaker: "Willapi"
response.text: Huh? But... that can't be...

response.speaker: "Willapi"
response.text: Villa Guiztli's meant to be a fully immersive experience. There's no way we'd leave in design flaws that didn't fit the theme...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: That's... actually a good point.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: So, is something else going on here, then? Paimon's getting a bad feeling all of a sudden...

talks.objective: Ride the cruise ship and proceed onward

dialogues.speaker: Mualani
dialogues.text: Ahh, I feel a bit more relaxed now.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Yeah. Honestly, it's our fault for messing with stuff that wasn't part of the attraction... Gah, this whole part of the trip's been an emotional rollercoaster.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Wait, are you two still thinking about it?

choices.text: If no one knew that cave was there...

response.speaker: Bennett
response.text: Yeah... I also think that adventure team's story is real, but I wouldn't be surprised if it took place a long, long time ago.

response.speaker: Bennett
response.text: Like... before this resort was even built.

response.speaker: "Willapi"
response.text: We're here! You must have been waiting for us to take a group photo, right?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Wait, that reminds Paimon... Wasn't the bounty for getting rid of El Capoctus Joquiratto five... million... Mora!?

response.speaker: Chasca
response.text: Yeah, I don't think we're gonna see a single coin of that. If they actually had to cough up Mora every time he got captured, Villa Guiztli would have gone under a long time ago.

response.speaker: "Willapi"
response.text: Hehe, exactly! The prize isn't real Mora, just a commemorative Mora-shaped chocolate coin stamped with that number.

response.speaker: "Willapi"
response.text: But since the chocolates aren't ready yet, I'll give you some Easybreeze Badges you can exchange for other items of your choice.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Oh, well... Paimon would have preferred the chocolate, but other gifts are fine too.

response.speaker: Mualani
response.text: I'll get the Kamera ready.

response.speaker: Mualani
response.text: Three, two, one...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Cactus!

choices.text: ...Do you think it could be related to Tenochtzitoc?

dialogues.speaker: "Willapi"
dialogues.text: Those guests don't look like they're fooling around... And where'd the cave come from anyway?

dialogues.speaker: Alpaca Sheriff
dialogues.text: *sigh* When oh when will our hero return...

dialogues.speaker: Bennett
dialogues.text: Who is this hero you just mentioned, Sheriff?

dialogues.speaker: Alpaca Sheriff
dialogues.text: Years ago, here in this town of ours, there lived a renowned gunslinger who always stood up for what was right.

dialogues.speaker: Alpaca Sheriff
dialogues.text: Famed for his unmatched courage and unparalleled sense of justice, he came to our aid countless times...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Ugh, what a bunch of rotten scoundrels! If you're gonna talk the talk, at least have the courage to back it up!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Let's check out that cave that got blown open. Maybe we'll find a clue to help us escape?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: El Capoctus Joquiratto's making a run for the cliffs — we can't let him get away!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: You know what? At the end of the day, we still did a good thing! We kept the town safe!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: So, if any more monsters show up... we'll just clear 'em out, like we always do!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: You know what? At the end of the day, we still did a good thing! We kept the town safe!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: So, if any more monsters show up... we'll just clear 'em out, like we always do!
